csv_project_name: A/E for Ovalwood Chiller & Cooling Tower Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio State University Mansfield Campus is seeking qualifications from Architect/Engineer (A/E) firms for the replacement of a 35-year-old, 210-ton central chiller and associated rooftop cooling tower at Ovalwood Hall, located at 1680 University Drive, Mansfield, OH 44906. The central chiller plant also provides chilled water through existing buried distribution loops to Conard Hall (1760 University Drive, Mansfield, OH 44906) and Eisenhower Hall (1640 University Drive, Mansfield, OH 44906).
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
